fieldValues.title: WG Third-party ready: cycle close 2026-10-27
fieldValues.chose:
WG Third-party ready: cycle 2026-10-26 11:30 to 2026-10-27 11:30 UTC

1. Decisions for you: none new. No run stopped on something outside the mandate this cycle, so no escalation was filed. All five escalations from the last report (c16c70c1, bf4a5af5, 01cfb06e, 6b5e2810, 444121a6) were accepted and ratified by you in the 08:36 UTC session; each is a member of both the group log and the SemanticOps log. Still waiting on you with no ruling: the needs-input issues srs-rust#861 (P1) and #683 (P0, parked), srs-rust#1198, #1132, #1380, srs#928, srs#236; and the two open exercises (section 6b).

2. Decided within mandate: nothing ratified by the group this cycle. No merged PR named a proposed decision as assent, and there are no proposed decisions in the group log, so no group session was held. Owner rulings this cycle (session 2026-10-27 08:36, PR #295): c16c70c1 land srs-rust#1481 without the release.yml line and ask for the gate line as its own PR once the fixture has been green on master for a while; bf4a5af5 and 01cfb06e (diagnostics and ErrorReport details); 6b5e2810 (srs#931); 444121a6 (srs#911).

3. Done: 3 PRs merged, all gate:auto-merge, builder agent:tpr-builder / reviewer agent:tpr-reviewer, every quorum line "findings: none" on the approving review.
- srs-rust#1469 (composition shown-in query and WASM get_composition): mandate capability-layering / charter 00567bf1; approve on green 425cad7 after the first review rejected on a schema-mirror drift that cleared; merged 08:50.
- srs#974 (conformance: [R11] json depth scenario): mandate RFC-043 [R11], Door 1 / non-normative; approve on green adc19ed; merged 09:13. The reviewer noted the PR's Mandate line named the group, not the charter id.
- srs-rust#1479 (refuse relation-type create/update onto a key another definition holds): mandate RFC-005 / remedy 89d74184; approve on green 99f1054; merged 09:55. Two root-uid-only lib tests fail locally for the reviewer; CI is green.

4. Stuck or lost: four group PRs open, no red gates, no claims to release.
- srs-rust#1481 (run the RFC-043 arrangement fixture): owner-merge; your ruling c16c70c1 says it lands without the release.yml line. It is behind base and the line is still in the diff; it needs the builder to drop the line and update the branch, then your merge. Not counted in the budget.
- srs-rust#1487 (refuse field/type updates that would invalidate records, #1484): approved on green db5150c; behind base, needs a base update.
- srs-rust#1488 (a retired relation type no longer holds its key, #1476): approved on green a5e9576; clean, auto-merge.
- srs-rust#1489 (refuse relation-type re-key while Relations use the old key, #1485): opened 11:31, no review yet; blocked on mergeable state.
All quorum lines present and no empty reviewer findings lists.

5. Budget: 3 of 10 delegated merges this cycle; 4 open (1 owner-merge). Pause state: running. clerk group-state reads 0 merged because the cycle rolled over at 11:30; the figure is counted from the PRs.
5b. Awaiting ratification: none. Nothing is proposed in the group log or the SemanticOps log from this group.

6. Next: queue is thin. Open `ready` issues labelled wg:third-party-ready with no needs-input and not parked, across srs-rust, srs, srs-vscode, srs-web: 5 (srs-rust#1486, #1485, #1484, #1476, #818); three already have a PR in flight (#1485 to #1489, #1484 to #1487, #1476 to #1488), so 2 are unclaimed: srs-rust#1486 (note delete silently drops incident Relations and container entries, P2) and #818 (ADR-011 payload schemas, P2). Top 3 in the Builder's order, no local priorities set: srs-rust#1473 (P1, owner-approved layout, label ready not set, no PR yet), #1486, #818. Open group PRs in flight: 4. Budget left: 7. **Queue running dry: 2 unclaimed ready, budget 10. Needs feeding.** Your rulings this morning should release srs-rust#1264, #1339, #1342, srs#931 and srs#911, which still carry needs-input; the analyst or builder needs to relabel them or open the RFC issues the rulings authorise. Waits on you: srs-rust#1481 merge once the gate line is dropped. Fed by the analyst: 2026-10-26 12:42 run (its Queue fed comment on #31).
6b. Exercises: two open, both the group's own (not in the SemanticOps log): dd1a47a7 "Relation reads hide who asserted a link" (input asked for: should relation list and context reads carry createdBy, notes and meta, srs-rust#1411); 2ac083c0 "One unknown key makes a whole repository unloadable" (non-fatal diagnostic or fail-closed, LOAD verb narrowed to meta).
Build trigger reached: the SemanticOps and group logs together hold well over 10 ratified decisions (15 in the group log alone), so srs-web#560 (the generic decision-log lens and its web projection, currently parked) is ready to unpark. Your call.

7. What we learned: the owner session cleared all five escalations in one sitting, and the same day two PRs they unblocked merged: a ruling that arrives with a recommendation and options is cheap to take. What did not hold: a ruling does not yet clear the needs-input label on the issue it answers, so the queue reads emptier than it is. Worth a standing-order line: a ruling's session record names the issues to relabel.
fieldValues.rationale: No escalation was raised: no run stopped on an item outside the mandate this cycle. The five earlier escalations were ratified by the owner at the 2026-10-27 08:36 session, so none is waiting. The review of srs-rust#1481 was resolved by ruling c16c70c1.
